adaptation_notes: Jolt allocates from static initializers in some builds only through these hooks once installed; install them in the memory phase, before the Factory exists.
diagnostics.assert-routed applies only when Jolt is built with JPH_ENABLE_ASSERTS; without it there are no assertion failures to route.

probes.registered_by: jolt_register_probes() for routing; the ThreadSanitizer run for tsan-clean

adaptation_notes: The shared scheduler must be installed (am::jobs::install) in the jobs phase before jolt_create_job_system().
Pass the adapter to PhysicsSystem::Update as its job system.
If the engine has its own scheduler, implement am::jobs::Scheduler over it; the adapter does not change.

probes.registered_by: the composition's entry point, from am::lifecycle

adaptation_notes: Create the TempAllocator and PhysicsSystem after jolt_register_types(), and destroy them before jolt_unregister_types(); record those steps too.
Link Jolt::Jolt so its PUBLIC JPH_* defines propagate to every glue file that includes Jolt headers.
